title: coap_slot_claim host suite: gcc-14 -Werror=conversion in slots_sanity_check blocks default host build
description: Found while verifying project-LICHEN-worker6-nwjl on heft. lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_slot_coord.c:264 (uint8_t expected = ordinal + i * gateway_count; int promotion then conversion to uint8_t) trips -Werror=conversion under gcc-14, failing the lichen/tests/coap_slot_claim host CMake build with default flags (the suite's CMakeLists enables strict conversion warnings). The logic is correct (i*gateway_count+ordinal always fits uint8_t given slot/superframe bounds: num_slots <= 255 and i < slot_count), so this is a host-flags portability nit, not a logic bug. Fix options: explicit cast ((uint8_t)(ordinal + i * gateway_count)) with a bounds comment, or make the loop variable/index arithmetic use uint8_t consistently, or drop -Werror=conversion from the suite flags. Until then the suite builds with -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-Wno-error=conversion (verified: builds and passes with gcc-14).
